description: Use this when the person tells you about cardio they did: a run, a ride, the rower, a walk. Record cardio the person did, with the numbers they give: minutes always; distance, heart rate, level, incline, energy and intervals only when given. Never invent them. effort is a talk test: easy (could hold a conversation), steady (short sentences), hard (a few words). Give sessionId to count it in that session (it fills the session's planned cardio when it is the same exercise), or null for cardio on its own. Null startedAt is just finished. Cardio counts as minutes, never kilograms. Applied immediately with Undo. Do not use for a lifting set; use log_set.

idempotencyKey.description: A new random id for this change (a UUID). Send the same one again only to retry this exact change.

title: Log cardio
